sentences.text: Shri R.B.S. Tomar, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri Manish Nayak, learned Panel Lawyer for the respon Case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for rival parties are heard.
This is the first application filed u/S.439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail by the petitioner.

The petitioner has been arrested on 30/01/2021 by Police Station Sihoniya, District Morena (M.P.)
in connection with Crime No.19/2021 registered in relation to the offence punishable u/Ss.420, 272,
273 of IPC and u/S.51, 57, 58 & 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out.
The petitioner is in custody since 30/01/2021 in respect of aforesaid offences where allegation against the petitioner is of making spurious milk.
Investigation in the matter is pending.

The offences alleged are not only against an individual but also against society at large which can cause widespread damage to the health and lives of the people and therefore, for the time being, no case for bail is made out.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands dismissed with liberty to the petitioner to revisit this Court after conclusion of investigation.
